english.note: Use this for a person or thing that becomes an object of public ridicule and thereby causes embarrassment.
Use this when the worthless person or thing is being held up as an object of ridicule.

examples.english: That promotional video was so outrageous that it became a public embarrassment.
examples.traditional: 嗰套宣傳片太離譜，成為全城笑柄。
examples.jyutping: go2 tou3 syun1 cyun4 pin2 taai3 lei4 pou2 sing4 wai4 cyun4 sing4 siu3 beng3

examples.english: That company is constantly criticized and has become a joke across the whole city.
examples.traditional: 嗰間公司成日畀人鬧，已經成為全城笑柄。
examples.jyutping: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 naau6 ji5 ging1 sing4 wai4 cyun4 sing4 siu3 beng3
